sources.quote: Torino Plant 3 (TO3) is not in scope of this record.
Scope: series production parts released at Torino Plant 1 (TO1) and Torino Plant 2 (TO2) for customers Stellantis (STL) and Cantieri Lombardi Mobility S.p.A. (CLM).
APPROVAL AP-0208: part BR-180; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese); billet grade EN AW-6061-T6; status APPROVED 2024-10-14 (PPAP-2024-091)

findings.why: The proposed receiving plant is TO3 for BR-180 / STL with billet from Alluminio B (Settimo Torinese). The only approval for that combination, AP-0208, is for plant TO1. The approved supplier list does not cover TO3, so no controlled record shows whether the source is approved there. Absence cannot be read as "not approved", so a person must confirm whether a TO3 release exists elsewhere.
